result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but a raw localization key is exposed as a section heading, indicating a missing translation string.

issues.description: Section header displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation entry so it renders as e.g. 'Popular near you'

issues.description: Category chips row (All, Pizza, Sushi...) is cut off at the right edge; last chip appears partially clipped
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has adequate padding so chips scroll fully into view

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped at the screen edge and its name is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...')
issues.suggestion: Verify carousel snapping and ensure truncated names wrap or use proper ellipsis with accessible full names
